The '''Forward Commander Mk II''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] produced on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the rogue [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] as part of his droid army. Its design was based on that of HK-47.

After HK-47 had transferred his [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|AI]] into a new body, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] tried to destroy the rogue droid in the crater of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]]. The Forward Commander Mk II led a group of [[HK-77 assassin droid|HK-77]] droids against the spacers but was destroyed in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The Forward Commander Mk II's first and only appearance was in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']], the third expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It appeared during the final stage of the [[:w:c:swg:Champion of Mustafar|Champion of Mustafar]] quest line that takes place in the crater of a volcano and pits a group of players against HK-47 and his droids.

It is unclear whether this droid was designed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on Mustafar based on HK-47's body they found in the wreckage of a [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|crashed ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] or by HK-47 himself after he gained control of the Separatists' old droid factory.

Among the items that players can loot from the droid's destroyed body are the [[Forward Commander Carbine|Forward Commander carbine]] and the [[Forward Commander knuckler]].
